title: SOC 2 Report Package Foundation
goal: Deliver the first compliance-packaged report output by adding a SOC 2 report variant built on the current methodology and reporting layers.
scope: Implement the first compliance slice as a SOC 2 report package only, using an explicit control-mapping table layered on top of existing finding methodology and report services. Keep ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and broader compliance programs out of scope for this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to a SOC 2 package only. Defer ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and non-report compliance workflows.
notes: Use a separate compliance mapping layer instead of changing Prompt 1 methodology definitions.
Expose the SOC 2 package through the existing report catalog and export paths.

success_criteria: The report catalog exposes a SOC 2 report variant alongside the existing executive, technical, evidence, and retest variants.
SOC 2 output groups findings under mapped SOC 2 control references using the existing methodology data.
The report includes a coverage summary and a truthful zero-finding path.
HTML, markdown, and PDF output stay aligned for the SOC 2 variant.
Report tests cover mapped, unmapped, and zero-finding runs.

acceptance_criteria: The SOC 2 variant appears only where the existing report catalog already exposes variants.
Unmapped findings stay visible and are marked honestly instead of being silently dropped from the compliance package.
The slice does not imply ISO 27001 or PCI DSS support yet.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
The SOC 2 package remains additive to the current report service and methodology layer.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the SOC 2 report slice and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new SOC 2 package and the frameworks still missing.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.
